facts.fact: Hagan 以 First Lord 的 Reeve 身份抵达 Threadbare Hall，Vedra 与 Daley 挤在塔楼窗口看他的队伍进门。
Daley 又一次不见踪影，Vedra 想起岛上那句老咒语，气少怕多。
facts.anchor: May crabs eat his toes so he must forevermore walk backward

facts.fact: Vedra 掀开后墙挂毯，发现一扇窄木门，门后是往下去的窄梯。
facts.anchor: she discovered a narrow wooden door

facts.fact: Vedra 摸黑下到吟游诗人廊台，躲在木屏风后听 Xaniko 与 Hagan 密谈。
facts.anchor: Xaniko and the reeve were having a private conversation below her

facts.fact: Xaniko 在掌心托出一物，Hagan 认出是 Scaeth 那条自吞其尾的蛇形印章戒指。
facts.anchor: the signet ring of Scaeth, the First Lord’s brother

facts.fact: Alastar 向 Scaeth 报兵：五十名自家骑士、五百名雇佣兵，再加一列还在出城的补给。
facts.anchor: Fifty of my own knights, five hundred mercenaries

facts.fact: Scaeth 命 Alastar 守住 River Baraillean 沿线，抓不到 Ewain 就要他的头。
facts.anchor: then I want the boy’s head

facts.fact: Xaniko 在书房宣布 Hagan 已咬钩，Flann 当面断言这人一定会背叛。
facts.anchor: Reeve Hagan has taken the bait
